title: Open-Source One-Click Wallet Library: No Extensions Needed

ms.promise:
・Functional dApp integration library code with a function that will be used to inject the wallet API into the browser.
・Implementation of all CIP-0030 wallet API functions with mocked data.
ms.criteria:
・The dApp integration library has a function that injects wallet API into the browser.
・The dApp integration library implements all wallet API functions from the CIP-0030 standard. The wallet API functions return mocked data.
ms.report:
Please see below the corrected evidence:
1.dApp integration library injects the wallet API
・dApp integration library code in an open-source GitHub repository: https://github.com/WingRiders/wallet/tree/dev/dapp-plugin
・Link to the part of the code in the GitHub repository that implements the function that injects this wallet API into the browser: https://github.com/WingRiders/wallet/blob/8dd73c2501898b4a2acf507f625384eda8d79d75/dapp-plugin/src/init/inject.ts#L44-L50
・Link to the documentation in the GitHub repository that describes how this function can be used by dApps: https://github.com/WingRiders/wallet/blob/8dd73c2501898b4a2acf507f625384eda8d79d75/README.md#wallet-dapp-plugin

2.dApp integration library returns mocked data
・Link to the part of the code in the GitHub repository that implements all functions from the CIP-0030 wallet API with mocked data: https://github.com/WingRiders/wallet/blob/8dd73c2501898b4a2acf507f625384eda8d79d75/dapp-plugin/src/init/inject.ts#L76-L120. Mocked data: https://github.com/WingRiders/wallet/blob/8dd73c2501898b4a2acf507f625384eda8d79d75/dapp-plugin/src/dataApi/DataApi.ts#L21-L55 and https://github.com/WingRiders/wallet/blob/8dd73c2501898b4a2acf507f625384eda8d79d75/dapp-plugin/src/gateway/WalletGateway.ts#L21-L30
・Link to the CIP-0030 standard to verify that the dApp integration library implements all functions according to the standard: https://developers.cardano.org/docs/governance/cardano-improvement-proposals/cip-0030/
・Link to a video showcasing that the implemented wallet API returns mocked data: https://github.com/WingRiders/wallet/blob/dev/catalyst-evidence/milestone-1-video.mov. Instructions to follow: https://github.com/WingRiders/wallet/blob/dev/catalyst-evidence/milestone-1.md

ms.report:
Please see the evidence with fixed links
Notes:
・you need to have some ADA in the wallet. It's mentioned in the evidence document.
・we are no longer operating public preprod so it has to be fixed to mainnet only. But the wallet supports it, it's just not connected.
・There is such function in https://wallet.wingriders.com - which is the wallet application where you manage your wallet. The example application https://wallet-example-app.wingriders.com/ is just an example dapp that integrates this wallet.

Evidence
・Updated dApp integration library

・New code pushed in the open-source GitHub repository for the dApp integration library - https://github.com/WingRiders/wallet/tree/dev/dapp-plugin
・Link to an example dApp application that integrates this wallet and displays user’s balance, addresses and UTxOs - https://wallet-example-app.wingriders.com/
